stories.title: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia have completed ratification of Makkah defence pact: FO
stories.brief: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia have completed the ratification processes for the Makkah defence pact while Turkiye was in the process of doing so, Foreign Office (FO) spokesperson Sajjad Haider Khan said on Friday.

stories.title: State counsel cross-examines prosecution witnesses in security breach case against Imaan, Hadi
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: A state-appointed counsel on Friday cross-examined all prosecution witnesses in a security breach case against lawyers Imaan Zainab Hazir-Mazari and Hadi Ali Chattha. Anti-terrorism court Judge Tahir Abbas Sipra presided over the hearing held inside Adiala jail on Friday, during which state counsel Atif Mehmood cross-examined a prosecution witness.

stories.title: Oil spill washes up on UAE beaches after tanker strike
stories.brief: Satellite images show oil spreading for miles along the coastline, threatening local marine wildlife

stories.title: At least 12 killed, 22 injured in road accident near Zero Point in Balochistan’s Uthal
stories.brief: KHUZDAR: At least 12 passengers were killed and around two dozen injured when a minibus and a passenger coach collided head-on near Zero Point in Uthal on the Quetta-Karachi Highway in Balochistan on Friday, police said.

stories.title: Zardari seeks stronger and mutually beneficial ties on Germany visit as countries mark 75 years of relations
stories.brief: The German president expressed hope that Pakistan and Germany would intensify their engagement in business and trade to promote bilateral commercial ties, educational collaboration and technological cooperation.

stories.title: NCCIA arrests 4 suspects over child sexual abuse material trafficking in Islamabad
stories.brief: The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) on Friday arrested four alleged members of an international gang involved in child sexual abuse and the production and sale of sexually explicit videos of minors. The arrests come amid an intensified nationwide crackdown by the NCCIA on online child exploitation, blackmail and digital fraud.

stories.title: Sanaullah says letter sent to Achakzai, urges opposition leader to meet PM Shehbaz
stories.brief: Earlier in the day, Achakzai stated that the premier could come to the opposition's office "and have tea with me or give me an invitation and wherever he wants to have negotiations I will go".

stories.title: At least 12 killed as passenger bus collides with van in Balochistan's Uthal
stories.brief: At least 12 people were killed and 22 injured when a passenger bus collided with a passenger van near Zero Point in Uthal, Lasbela district of Balochistan, on Friday, police said. According to police, the bus was travelling from Lasbela to Karachi when the two vehicles collided near Uthal Zero Point, resulting in heavy casualties.

stories.title: Security forces kill 10 Indian-sponsored terrorists in Gwadar operations: ISPR
stories.brief: Security forces killed 10 terrorists, including a woman, during operations in Gwadar after Indian-sponsored Fitna al-Hindustan terrorists attempted attacks near the Gabd border crossing and in Gwadar city, the military’s media wing said on Friday.

stories.title: New Greece law bans social media for under-15s
stories.brief: Greece's parliament passed a law Friday banning children under 15 from social media, joining a growing number of countries imposing curbs on young people's use of the apps.

stories.title: Wales plans to ban steel pylons as government launches consultation
stories.brief: The Welsh government says it is consulting on an "undergrounding-first approach" to electricity lines.

stories.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
stories.brief: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.

stories.title: PSG v Lyon moved as Paris prepares for more protests
stories.brief: Paris St-Germain's Ligue 1 match against Lyon at the Parc des Princes is pushed back 24 hours as the French capital prepares for another weekend of protests.
